How does the matcher decide?
  1. Clean the list. Merge repeat entries, use the newest preferences, and remove people who are out of date or already booked.
  2. Apply clinic rules. Check therapist restrictions, including prenatal eligibility.
  3. Check the opening. Compare day, start time, appointment length, and notice.
  4. Choose safely. Keep only people who pass every known rule. Unclear records are not offered.
  5. Show up to three. Use current waitlist order and explain the decision for each opening.
